body: SHANKPIT commit 1facc5e. Duck/Unicorn/Ghost/Frog/Tree/Pizza (all from TYLER/just_a_duck.md, the same source transcript REDGARDEN's own roster came from) plus Tyler himself, as cosmetic player skins in the parent SHANKPIT engine (explicitly not shankpit-460). New CharacterDefinition entries + draw_player_skin_*() functions, same low-poly box style as the existing Rexx skin. Also found and fixed a pre-existing broken build along the way: draw_hud()'s MODE_STORY branch referenced an undeclared now_ms -- confirmed via git stash this predates this commit entirely, fixed with a local SDL_GetTicks() call. Verified via make lobby (clean) and test_player_model.c (6/6 passing). Closes BACKLOG S170-110.
title: 7 new cosmetic skins: it's-a-duck cast + Tyler, og SHANKPIT engine
